586-678-5686.description:
Cast Priest of Gix by paying its mana cost.
When Priest of Gix enters, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning Priest of Gix from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability, creating a Blood token.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2921-6972-8174.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Mabel.
When Mabel dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Mabel enters, it triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

934-4881-6909-8198.manaNeeded: {4}{B}{G} plus {2}{B} if Activated Sleeper is in your hand
934-4881-6909-8198.easyPrerequisites: Amorphous Axe is attached to Carnage.
934-4881-6909-8198.description:
Cast Trystan's Command by paying its mana cost, creating a token copy of Carnage.
Put the nontoken Carnage into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Carnage token enters, it triggers, putting Activated Sleeper from your graveyard onto the battlefield, or another applicable card otherwise.
If Activated Sleeper was not returned in step 3, cast it by paying {2}{B}. Regardless, choose to have Activated Sleeper enter as a copy of Carnage.
Put Activated Sleeper into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When Activated Sleeper enters, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Carnage.
Repeat from step 5.

4694-5147-6258-7306.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
4694-5147-6258-7306.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Thunderous Velocipede.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to its target.
Repeat from step 1.

1479-2841-3534-8103.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Verdant Catacombs.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
1479-2841-3534-8103.notablePrerequisites: You control seven or more lands with different names.
1479-2841-3534-8103.description:
Fetch a land using Verdant Catacombs.
When the fetched land enters, Field of the Dead and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Field of the Dead trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Field of the Dead from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Field of the Dead triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

728-2376--5.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it and at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Rhythm of the Wild.
Remove a -1/-1 counter and a +1/+1 counter from that creature as a state-based action.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat

2692-3899-7084.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Felidar Retreat triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat.

2728-2921-4153-7957.easyPrerequisites:
Genestealer Patriarch does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent controls a creature.
Rikku does not have summoning sickness.
2728-2921-4153-7957.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two additional creatures.
2728-2921-4153-7957.description:
Declare Genestealer Patriarch as an attacker.
Genestealer Patriarch's first ability triggers, putting an infection counter on a creature an opponent controls.
Activate Rikku's ability by paying its cost, moving the infection counter from the opponent's creature onto a creature you control.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the creature with an infection counter on it.
When the creature dies, Resourceful Defense and Genestealer Patriarch's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Resourceful Defense trigger, putting an infection counter onto another creature you control.
Resolve the Genestealer Patriarch trigger, causing you to create a token copy of the sacrificed creature that is a Tyranid in addition to its other types.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat from step 4.

4779-5777-7810.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Food.
4779-5777-7810.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Grunt by sacrificing a Food.
Camellia triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token and a Food artifact token.
Resolve the Krark-Clan Grunt ability
Repeat.

2457-4289-5223-7824.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the creature tokens by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and with power 4 or greater

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2074-5147-6972.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Vorapede
When Vorapede dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Vorapede
When Vorapede dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve both Goblin Bombardment abilities from step 1 and 3.
Repeat.
2074-5147-6972.notes: If Vorapede starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 3 instead.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

997-6972-7511.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Witch-king
When Witch-king dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Witch-king
When Witch-king dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve both Woe Strider abilities from step 1 and 3.
Repeat.
997-6972-7511.notes: If Witch-king starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 3 instead.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to either Thunderblust or Rattleblaze Scarecrow

1236-3259-3521-6431.easyPrerequisites: The persist creature with Breath of Fury attached doesn't have a -1/-1 counter on it.
1236-3259-3521-6431.notablePrerequisites: Opponents cannot block creatures you control.
1236-3259-3521-6431.description:
Deal combat damage using the persist creature that has Breath of Fury attached.
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the other persist creature, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
When the sacrificed creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the creature enters, Celes's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Repeat each combat phase.

1491-4474-6218-7315.description:
Activate Pheres-Band Tromper by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Pheres-Band Tromper by paying {1} and putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Pheres-Band Tromper triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Repeat.

944-4217-7302.description:
Cast Whirlwind Technique by paying its mana cost, targeting any applicable target(s).
Holding priority, cast Lutri by paying its mana cost reduced by Planar Gate.
When Lutri enters, it triggers, copying Whirlwind Technique targeting Lutri.
Resolve Whirlwind Technique, airbending Lutri.
Holding priority, cast Lutri from exile by paying {0} due to Planar Gate.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.n: The Enigma Jewel // Locus of Enlightenment

74-2043-4460-6311.description:
Activate Urza by paying {6}, targeting Radiant Lotus.
Locus of Enlightenment triggers, copying Urza's ability, targeting Radiant Lotus.
Resolve both Urza abilities, creating two token copies of Radiant Lotus that are 1/1 Soldier artifact creatures.
Activate a Radiant Lotus token by tapping it and sacrificing both Radiant Lotus tokens, targeting yourself.
Locus of Enlightenment triggers, copying the Radiant Lotus token's ability, targeting yourself.
Resolve both Radiant Lotus abilities, adding twelve mana of any color.
Repeat.

1169-3259-5722.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent controls no creatures.
Breath of Fury attached to a creature other than Wasitora that doesn't have summoning sickness
1169-3259-5722.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent who controls no creatures using Wasitora and the creature that has Breath of Fury attached, triggering Breath of Fury and Wasitora.
Resolve the Wasitora trigger, creating a 3/3 Cat Dragon creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Cat Dragon, then causing you to untap all creatures and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat damage.

719-3967-5310-6879.description:
Cast Bloodghast by paying {B}{B}.
When Bloodghast enters as an Ally due to Xenograft, Haru triggers, earthbending a land.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Bloodghast.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing a land creature.
When the land creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the land enters, Bloodghast triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Bloodghast enters as an Ally due to Xenograft, Haru triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Yahenni ability from step 4.
Repeat from step 3.
719-3967-5310-6879.notes: If the chosen land can enter untapped and produce mana, you may do so each iteration to get infinite mana of those color(s) and type(s).

250-779-1479-5414-6517.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
250-779-1479-5414-6517.description:
Play Dakmor Salvage.
When Dakmor Salvage enters, Dragonback Assault and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Troubled Healer by sacrificing Dakmor Salvage.
The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
If a land was milled this way, The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Troubled Healer ability
Resolve the Dragonback Assault trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Dakmor Salvage from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dakmor Salvage enters the battlefield, Dragonback Assault triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

24-918-4090.description:
Cast Wheel of Misfortune by paying {2}{R}, choosing an arbitrarily large number and having Wheel of Misfortune deal that much damage to Donna Noble instead of you due to Pariah if you chose the largest number.
Donna Noble triggers, dealing that much damage to an applicable target.
24-918-4090.notes: If you didn't choose the highest number, Wheel of Misfortune will deal damage to the opponent(s) who did equal to that number.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Grim Poppet and with toughness 2 or greater

1084-3108-4865.description:
Activate Grim Poppet by removing a -1/-1 counter from it, putting a -1/-1 counter on Vesuvan Shapeshifter.
Flourishing Defenses triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Vesuvan Shapeshifter by removing a -1/-1 counter from it, putting a -1/-1 counter on Grim Poppet.
Flourishing Defenses triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

1661-1987-4045-4423.description:
Activate Mystic Sanctuary and Ur-Golem's Eye by tapping them, adding {C}{C}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {2}{U}, blinking Mystic Sanctuary and Ur-Golem's Eye.
When Mystic Sanctuary enters untapped, it triggers, putting Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

3764-4871-5686.description:
Activate Summoning Station by tapping it, creating a 2/2 Pincher creature token.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the Pincher.
When the Pincher dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Summoning Station triggers, untapping it.
Repeat.

3941-4067-4823-6281.description:
Activate Coveted Jewel by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding Timeless Witness.
Hashaton triggers, causing you to pay {2}{U} to create a tapped token copy of Timeless Witness that is a 4/4 Zombie.
When the Timeless Witness token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Timeless Witness from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mind Over Matter ability, untapping Coveted Jewel.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to Wight of the Reliquary

2178-5627-6517.easyPrerequisites: Wight of the Reliquary does not have summoning sickness.
2178-5627-6517.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
2178-5627-6517.description:
Activate Wight of the Reliquary by tapping it and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Wight of the Reliquary triggers, untapping Wight of the Reliquary.
Resolve the Wight of the Reliquary ability from step 1, causing you to search your library for a land card and put it onto the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters the battlefield, Dragonback Assault triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

880-4826-6517.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
880-4826-6517.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature you control, searching your library for a land card with a basic land type and putting it on the battlefield untapped due to Archelos.
When the land enters the battlefield, Dragonback Assault triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with at least one +1/+1 counter on it

331-4120-4968.description:
Activate Deathbringer Thoctar by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting two +1/+1 counters on it due to Vigor.
Activate Deathbringer Thoctar by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 2 damage to any target.
Repeat as desired.
331-4120-4968.notes: You may target a creature you control in step 2 to put +1/+1 counters on it due to Vigor.

2457-4094-5794-6441.easyPrerequisites: Kaya has at least two loyalty counters on it.
2457-4094-5794-6441.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating four 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate Baylen's first ability twice by tapping the four Insect tokens, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat from step 2.

1651-1781-4321-5251.description:
Activate Thran Forge by tapping it, causing Emmara to become an artifact until end of turn.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping Emmara and another artifact, targeting Emmara.
Emmara triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token and a Food token.
Resolve the Clock of Omens ability, untapping Emmara.
Repeat from step 2.

1445-4050-5631.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand and a creature card in your graveyard.
1445-4050-5631.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Skeleton Crew triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature token, adding {B}.
Repeat.

3169-5291-6250.description:
Cast Daretti by paying {4}{R} plus commander tax if applicable
When Daretti enters the battlefield, it and Genesis Chamber trigger.
Resolve the Genesis Chamber trigger, creating a 1/1 Myr artifact creature token.
Resolve the Daretti trigger, causing you to sacrifice the Myr to return Cursed Mirror from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Daretti.
Put Cursed Mirror into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Cursed Mirror and Genesis Chamber trigger.
Resolve the Genesis Chamber trigger, creating a 1/1 Myr artifact creature token.
Resolve the Cursed Mirror trigger, causing you to sacrifice the Myr to return Cursed Mirror from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Daretti.
Repeat from step 5

618-2511-5887.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Werefox Bodyguard.
When the Werefox Bodyguard token enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Kiki-Jiki until Werefox Bodyguard leaves the battlefield.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the Werefox Bodyguard token.
When the Werefox Bodyguard token dies, Kiki-Jiki is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

1409-2895-3756-4826.manaNeeded: {1}{G}{U} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
1409-2895-3756-4826.description:
Cast Uro by paying {1}{G}{U}
When Uro enters the battlefield, its first and second abilities trigger, as well as Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, pairing it and Uro.
Resolve the second Uro trigger, causing you to draw a card, gain 3 life, and put Izzet Boilerworks from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Izzet Boilerworks enters untapped due to Archelos, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Izzet Boilerworks by tapping it, adding {U}{R}.
Resolve the Izzet Boilerworks trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Uro by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
Repeat from step 2.

152-851-2034-5446.description:
Activate Cogwork Assembler by paying {7}, creating two token copies of Esika's Chariot.
When the Esika's Chariots enter the battlefield, their first abilities trigger, creating four 2/2 Cat creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar four times by sacrificing the Cats, adding eight {C}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may forego sacrificing the Cats and/or target any other artifact using Cogwork Assembler.

1124-1636-1945-2034-4091.notablePrerequisites: Aphetto Alchemist does not have summoning sickness.
1124-1636-1945-2034-4091.description:
Activate Chandra's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, creating two 3/1 Elemental creature tokens with haste.
When the Elementals enter the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers twice.
Resolve the first trigger, untapping all creatures.
Activate Aphetto Alchemist by tapping it, untapping The Chain Veil.
Resolve the second Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Activate Aphetto Alchemist by tapping it, untapping target artifact or creature.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the two Elemental tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Activate The Chain Veil by paying {4} and tapping it, allowing you an additional activation of your planeswalkers' loyalty abilities this turn.
Repeat.

2493-3603-5195.description:
Cast Cloudshift by paying {W}, targeting Archaeomancer
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve Cloudshift, blinking Archaeomancer
When Archaeomancer enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Cloudshift to your hand from your graveyard.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}.
Repeat.

2067-3858-5135.notablePrerequisites: Your life total plus the number of creatures you control is equal to or greater than nineteen.
2067-3858-5135.description:
Cast Storm Herd by paying {8}{W}{W}, causing you to create a number of 1/1 Pegasus creature tokens equal to your life total.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Mayael's Aria triggers, causing you to put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control, gain ten life and win the game.

586-1591-2232-3415-5218.notablePrerequisites: You have a nonartifact black creature card in hand with mana value two or less.
586-1591-2232-3415-5218.description:
Cast Priest of Gix by discarding another nonartifact black creature card with mana value two or less.
Conspiracy Theorist triggers, causing you to exile the discarded card from your graveyard and allowing you to cast it this turn.
Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Cloudstone Curio.
Resolve the Priest of Gix trigger, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Holding priority, cast the black creature from exile by paying its mana cost.
The creature enters the battlefield, triggering Cloudstone Curio, returning Priest of Gix from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger from step 3, returning the black creature to your hand.
Repeat.

251-933-1494.notablePrerequisites: Denry Klin has at least five +1/+1 counters on it.
251-933-1494.description:
At the beginning of your end step, Conjurer's Closet triggers, blinking Sage of Hours.
Sage of Hours enters the battlefield, triggering Denry Klin, putting at least five +1/+1 counters on Sage of Hours.
Activate Sage of Hours by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to take at least one extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.
